properties.name: spring.data.rest.base-path
properties.description: Base path to be used by Spring Data REST to expose repository resources.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.default-media-type
properties.description: Content type to use as a default when none is specified.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.detection-strategy
properties.description: Strategy to use to determine which repositories get exposed.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.enable-enum-translation
properties.description: Whether to enable enum value translation through the Spring Data REST default resource bundle.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.limit-param-name
properties.description: Name of the URL query string parameter that indicates how many results to return at once.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.page-param-name
properties.description: Name of the URL query string parameter that indicates what page to return.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.return-body-on-create
properties.description: Whether to return a response body after creating an entity.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.return-body-on-delete
properties.description: Whether to return a response body after deleting an entity.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.return-body-on-update
properties.description: Whether to return a response body after updating an entity.

properties.name: spring.data.rest.sort-param-name
properties.description: Name of the URL query string parameter that indicates what direction to sort results.
